claims.text: The rider's side of this pickup was live to the last message. The chat log shows every driver message delivered and read within about fifteen seconds (read receipts 16:02:44, 16:03:01, 16:07:29), the rider's own reply 'coming coming 2 min' sent at 16:08:02 and read at 16:08:11, the driver's 'ok no problem' at 16:08:20, and a 34-second in-app call placed by the driver at 16:09:40 which the rider answered. Limb (a) of the rider-contact clause asks whether the rider sent a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window; an ETA for reaching the vehicle is coordinating content, and the rider makes out that limb. She does not press the clause as a whole, because limb (b) fails on this record (the driver replied 18 seconds after her message and placed an answered in-app call before terminating) and limb (c) is failed on the trace. The rider relies on this record for the narrower point that she was engaged and reachable, and that nothing in it supports a suggestion that she ignored the driver or could not be reached.

Rider presence is not an element of the no-show charge and the rider's distance from the pin cannot be used to supply one. Every condition in POL-NS-01 runs off the driver's record - the 'arrived' event, the geofence position, the measured dwell, and the termination code - and POL-NS-06 fixes the refund 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded'. The rider accepts that the trace's rider block shows 141 fixes, none of them qualifying inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and a distance from the pickup pin of 633.9 to 646.4 m, and she does not ask the Judge to find that she was standing at the pickup point. Her point is that this fact answers none of the four conditions and must not be weighed as though it did.

No adverse finding and no escalation can be built out of either profile. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 3 is a lifetime counter which POL-GEN-01 lists as context only and which may not be substituted for the trailing-window rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which stands at 1 and falls short of the 3-or-more threshold in POL-NS-09(d); disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged either. The rider asks the Judge to record in the reasoning that her history carries no ground of decision and that escalation on abuse grounds is not available on this record.

The traffic advisory does not exist, and its absence proves nothing against the rider. EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload. Under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable, so nothing may be asserted from it; in particular, no advisory can be used to extend, excuse or accumulate the waiting clock under POL-NS-06(i), whose limb the derived block records as unavailable on this trip. The rider asks the Judge to disregard any assertion built on an artifact that is not in the bundle.

The rider states plainly what she cannot support rather than stretching a clause to fit it. There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the derived trace records one continuous in-geofence run of 585 seconds (16:02:10 to 16:11:55, 60 qualifying fixes) against a LARGE_VENUE minimum of 300 seconds. There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: the 16:02:25 'arrived' event falls inside that run, so the trace does not place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the marker. POL-NS-02 is satisfied because qualifying in-radius fixes exist, and POL-NS-03 is closed to the rider because those fixes put the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius rather than outside it. The rider's submission is confined to the points argued above, and to her request that nothing be added to the driver's side of the scale that the record does not contain.

claims.text: The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-07-30T16:02:25+08:00, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the record without any inference.

The GPS trace, which is unbroken at 10-second cadence with 100 percent coverage and no gaps, places the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 16:02:10 — fifteen seconds BEFORE the arrived event — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, comfortably meeting POL-NS-02's requirement of at least 3 consecutive in-radius fixes at 25 m accuracy or better. POL-NS-01 limb (b) is therefore satisfied.

The driver held position inside the geofence in a single continuous run of 585 seconds, from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires. That is 285 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for the LARGE_VENUE zone class, so the required dwell is met with almost double the minimum.

There is no waiting-period shortfall to trigger a refund under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell of 585 seconds against the 300-second minimum produces a shortfall of minus 285 seconds. The clause is simply not engaged.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the termination came after the required dwell had elapsed at 16:07:10, with no boarding event anywhere in the record. Limb (d) is satisfied.

POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the 16:02:25 arrival marker the driver was already stationary inside the arrival radius at 0 kph, not more than 300 m from the pin and nowhere near the 15 kph motion threshold, so the marker is not a false-arrival event.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails outright: the rider's single coordinating message at 16:08:02 was answered by the driver 18 seconds later at 16:08:20, far inside the 120-second window, and the driver additionally placed an answered 34-second in-app voice call at 16:09:40. Where the driver replied in time, the clause does not apply.

Even the rider-presence limb of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively failed, not merely undecidable: the rider's own device track is available and records 141 fixes that never come closer than 633.9 m to the pin, yielding 0 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. The rider was nowhere near the pickup point throughout the wait.

The chat log corroborates the driver's account independently of the GPS: the system 'Your driver has arrived' fired at 16:02:26, the driver posted his plate and location at 16:02:40 and again at 16:07:15, every message was delivered and read, and the rider answered 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02 — an acknowledgement that she was still coming and had not yet reached the vehicle.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver was stationary INSIDE the arrival radius at the pickup pin rather than outside it; the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling is not reached on the driver's side. There is no wrong-face-of-the-venue case here for the rider to exploit.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee, being SGD 6.40, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and the ratio against 143 completed trips in 30 days is 0.014, below 0.08. Both limbs of the check must fail to withhold, and both do.

The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is correct and cannot be attacked as a billing defect under POL-NS-08(d): under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee is SGD 8.00, which is exactly the line itemised, and the fare breakdown reconciles with a difference of 0.00.

EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no traffic advisory covers Depot Road in this window. I disclose that impairment and do not rely on it: no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed, because the driver's time in the geofence is a single unbroken 585-second run, so the absent advisory neither helps nor hurts either side.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your $8.00 no-show charge is not refunded, and every condition the no-show policy requires is met on this record — all on unbroken 10-second GPS telemetry (EV-GPS-00208, 100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0) and on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00208, weight 1.0). The driver logged an 'arrived' event at 16:02:25, and the GPS places him inside the 120 m arrival radius for your LARGE_VENUE pickup from 16:02:10 — fifteen seconds before that event — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, so the arrival test is comfortably passed. He then held position in a single continuous run of 585 seconds, from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, which is 285 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for the zone class, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 under reason RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. There is therefore no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06 (shortfall of minus 285 seconds) and no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05 (he was stationary inside the radius at the marker, not moving and not 300 m away), so neither of those refund routes is open. Your reliance on POL-NS-04 also fails: the driver replied 'ok no problem' 18 seconds after your 16:08:02 message and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40, so limb (b) — no reply within 120 seconds and no in-app call before termination — is not met, and the clause does not apply. The rider-track showing your device never came closer than 633.9 m to the pin is genuinely recorded but it decides nothing: rider presence is not an element of POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-06 fixes the refund 'whether or not the rider was present', so it was not weighed against you. The absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00208-01: MISSING, weight 0.0) proves nothing in either direction and was not relied on; its only effect is to make accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, which is immaterial because the driver's hold was one unbroken run. Your prior_no_show_flags of 3 is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only; it carried no weight, and with no_show_disputes_30d at 1 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d at 0 on both profiles, no abuse-based escalation is available. To the driver: the fee stands and you are owed compensation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays you 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 6.40, the remaining SGD 1.60 being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: your no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the threshold of 4) and 2 divided by 143 completed trips in 30 days is 0.014 (below 0.08). The SGD 8.00 charge is the correct figure — the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee — so there is no billing defect under POL-NS-08(d). No artifact the ruling rests on is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): clock skew is 5 seconds at arrival and nil at start and termination, the trace has no gap over 120 seconds and well over 6 fixes, the chat log's 6 messages equal the trip record's chat_message_count, and the fare reconciles exactly. Confidence 0.90.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this is a verified rider no-show, so the SGD 8.00 charge stands and the driver is paid for the wait.

WHY THE CHARGE STANDS (POL-NS-01). All four conditions hold on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00208) and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00208), both at full weight. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:02:25. (b) The trace — unbroken 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps — places the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius of 120 m from 16:02:10, fifteen seconds BEFORE the arrived marker, with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes (the test needs three). (c) The driver held one continuous in-geofence run from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55 = 585 seconds against the 300-second minimum for LARGE_VENUE, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires — 285 seconds beyond the minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the 300 seconds ran out at 16:07:10, and no boarding event appears anywhere.

NO DISPLACING CLAUSE APPLIES. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker): at 16:02:25 the trace puts the driver stationary inside the radius at 0 kph, not beyond 300 m and not at the 15 kph motion threshold — the marker is genuine. POL-NS-06 (short waiting period): the dwell exceeds the minimum by 285 seconds, so there is no shortfall to refund. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance): the driver was inside the 120 m arrival radius, not outside it, so the 400 m wrong-entrance test is never reached. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered): limb (b) fails outright — the rider's coordinating message was sent at 16:08:02 and the driver replied 'ok no problem' 18 seconds later at 16:08:20, and he also placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40; the clause does not apply where the driver replied in time. The rider's device was also not at the pickup point (141 fixes, never nearer than about 634 m; zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m radius), though rider presence is not an element of the charge. The rider's own advocate does not press POL-NS-04 and accepts there is no shortfall, no false marker and no wrong-entrance case.

ruling.explanation:
This is a rider-filed no-show dispute. The charge stands, and the driver is paid. Here is why, on the figures.

Ms —, your account that the driver never came is not supported by the record. EV-GPS-00208 (GPS trace, weight 1.0, complete: 100% coverage, 10-second cadence, no gaps) shows the driver's vehicle held position inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at The Interlace main guardhouse for a single unbroken 585 seconds, from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55 — derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec = 585 s, with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes and no excursion. That is 285 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup. EV-TRIP-00208 (trip record, weight 1.0) records the 'arrived' event at 16:02:25, the cancellation at 16:12:10 by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding event, and the answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40. All four POL-NS-01 conditions are therefore met: (a) an arrived event; (b) in-geofence at 16:02:10, before that event; (c) 585 s dwell measured from the first qualifying fix; and (d) termination on RIDER_NO_SHOW after the 300-second dwell elapsed at 16:07:10. POL-NS-02 is satisfied on 60 qualifying in-radius fixes (three are required).

None of the rider-exonerating clauses helps the rider. POL-NS-04 fails at limb (b): she did send a coordinating message ('coming coming 2 min', 16:08:02), but the driver replied 18 seconds later ('ok no problem', 16:08:20) and placed an answered in-app call at 16:09:40 — a reply inside the 120-second window means the clause does not apply; in any event limb (c) is affirmatively failed (her own trace never comes closer than 633.9 m to the pin, 0 qualifying fixes against the 150 m rider-presence radius). POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival marker falls inside the 585-second in-geofence run and the driver was stationary at 0 kph within the radius, nowhere near the 300 m / 15 kph triggers. POL-NS-06 is not engaged: the derived shortfall is minus 285 seconds, i.e. no shortfall. POL-NS-03 is closed: the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius (nearest approach 28.8 m), not outside it, so the 400 m wrong-entrance test is not reached.

The fee is correct. Under the fee schedule's resolution rule the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee is SGD 8.00, which is exactly the line itemised in EV-FARE-00208 (difference 0.00), so there is no billing defect under POL-NS-08(d).

POL-NS-07 therefore applies in full: the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee, being SGD 6.40, and the anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and the ratio against 143 completed trips in 30 days is 0.014 (below 0.08); both limbs are required and neither fires. Your SGD 8.00 charge stands as it presently is; the SGD 6.40 is paid to the driver by the platform, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries that same figure because this is a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and carries no fact; no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) was needed on a single unbroken run, so its absence changes nothing. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d), and your request for a call is noted but no clause produces a referral on these facts.

Rider: I understand you waited and could not get through to the driver, but on the record the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is properly chargeable and stands. Driver: your arrival and wait are verified, and you are entitled to compensation of SGD 6.40.

Why the charge stands (POL-NS-01). (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25 on 30 July 2026. (b) The GPS trace, unbroken at 10-second intervals with 100% coverage and no gaps, places the vehicle inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 16:02:10 — 15 seconds before the marker — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, far above the three consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 requires at 25 m accuracy. (c) The driver then held position in one continuous in-geofence run of 585 seconds, measured from the first qualifying fix at 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, against the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum — a margin of 285 seconds. (d) The driver terminated the trip at 16:12:10 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required 300 seconds had elapsed at 16:07:10, with no boarding event. All four limbs hold, so the fee is chargeable unless a rider-favouring clause displaces it.

None does. POL-NS-06 is not engaged: measured dwell 585 s against required 300 s is a shortfall of minus 285 s, so there is no waiting-period breach. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the 16:02:25 marker the driver was stationary at 0 kph inside the 120 m radius, not over 300 m away or moving at 15 kph, so the marker is not false. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it within 400 m, so this is not a wrong-entrance case. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (b) fails outright because the driver replied 'ok no problem' 18 seconds after the rider's 'coming coming 2 min' message and additionally placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed as well — the rider's own device track sits 633.9 m to 646.4 m from the pin across the whole window with 0 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. The rider's claim that her presence is not an element of the no-show charge is correct as a matter of the clause, and I accept it, but it does not help her: the charge is established by the driver's record alone.

On the money (POL-NS-07). With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is paid 80% of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee = SGD 6.40; the residual SGD 1.60 is retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and the ratio against 143 completed trips in 30 days is about 0.014, below 0.08, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. The SGD 8.00 line itself is correct: under the fee schedule the chargeable fee is the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee, which is SGD 8.00 — the fare breakdown reconciles with a difference of 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

I looked for evidence defects and found none. No clock skew (the arrival marker sits within a few seconds of its nearest GPS fix, and termination times agree at 16:12:10); no sampling gap (120 fixes, zero gaps); the chat log's 6 messages match the 6 the trip record counts; and the fee reconciles as above. The traffic advisory for this window is absent — EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT — so it can carry no fact and no accumulation of dwell is available under POL-NS-06(i); no party needs it, since the dwell is a single unbroken run. No escalation ground applies: neither profile shows any dispute between these two parties, and the rider's trailing-30-day no-show dispute count is 1, below the threshold of 3; her lifetime prior_no_show_flags figure of 3 is context only and I give it no weight. The deciding facts rest on artifacts all at full weight 1.0, so confidence is 0.90.

Outcome: the fee stands (it is not refunded) and the driver is paid SGD 6.40, which is the amount this ruling moves.
